# Camp Resource: Tree Sap Collector

Stick to the basics and harness nature's glue with this Tree Sap Collector!

Tree Sap Collector dispenses Adhesive.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Tree Sap Collector__

**Produces**

Adhesive

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 Adhesive

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __The Lookout Bundle__ - 1800 Atoms

Atom Shop - __Tree Sap Collector__ - 500 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 Seconds.

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

6 Flamingo Units
